technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Security to implement file-based and LDAP-based authentication chains with role-based access control (Admin and Viewer roles) targeting http://localhost:9393/ endpoints.
Implement Kerberized HDFS Sink using Spring Integration / Spring Cloud Stream HDFS support, enabling Kerberos keytab and principal configuration.
Build HBase Sink, File Roll Sink, and JMX Source as reusable Spring Cloud Stream / Spring Integration starter modules with standardized configuration properties.

Conduct the Mass-Ingest Spike (U5) focusing on evaluating alternative options (e.g., CDC/Debezium, Spark/Flink batch connectors, or Sqoop equivalents) without delivering production code for U5 in this increment.
assumptions: Development will target Java 17 and Spring Framework 6.x / Spring Boot 3.x.
Test environments for LDAP, Kerberized Hadoop, HBase, and JMX endpoints (or containerized mocks via Testcontainers) are available for development and integration testing.
Security for file-based user management will rely on standard Spring Security configuration properties (e.g., SecurityProperties / user details file).
All work, including implementation, testing, spike documentation, and build integration, will be executed by a single developer.

activities.activity_description: Design the endpoint security structure (File & LDAP authentication, RBAC), establish module structures for HDFS Kerberos, HBase, File Roll sinks, and JMX source, and draft initial technical specifications.

Implement Spring Security configurations supporting file-based and LDAP-based authentication for endpoints on port 9393, alongside role-based access controls for Admin and Viewer roles, including unit and security test coverage.
Implement HDFS Sink module with Kerberos authentication support (principal, keytab, and user ticket cache configuration) and integration tests.
Investigate database mass-ingestion options non-dependent on standard JDBC drivers, collaborate with stakeholders, and document the architecture and technical specification.
Develop HBase Sink module to enable random, real-time write access into HBase, including client configuration, payload serialization, and integration tests.
Implement local file system File Roll sink module with configurable rolling policies (size/time triggers, pathing, naming conventions) and unit/integration tests.
Implement JMX source module using Spring Integration JMX inbound channel adapters to publish/subscribe to JMX notifications and map payloads into stream channels.
Perform end-to-end integration testing, write user documentation and configuration guides, and update build scripts and CI pipeline definitions.
